Interviews are usually formal settings where the person is being evaluated for a job or some position. The way someone dresses can leave a first impression, which is really important. An ironed shirt suggests that the person has taken the time to prepare and present themselves neatly. It shows attention to detail and respect for the occasion. In many cultures, especially in professional environments, a clean and well-pressed shirt is a sign of professionalism and seriousness about the job. On the other hand, maybe in some more casual workplaces, an ironed shirt might seem too formal. But generally, in most interview settings, dressing neatly is expected.
